notes.title: Let’s get on the right track for change!
notes.notes:
Design your own layout, plan your tracks, and bring your ideal train yard to life – Train Yard Builder celebrates creativity and thoughtful planning. And this week, it also celebrates purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/e2cc5fdb2c02fdba6d80cdc0ebdea0cfc432e792.png[/img]

As part of the [b][i]Ocean Fest Steam Sale 2025[/i][/b], we’re donating [b]10% of profits to ocean conservation efforts[/b]. From [b]June 5th to June 12th[/b], your passion for building can directly support cleaner seas and healthier marine life. The game is [b]40% off[/b] during the event – a perfect chance to start building for fun and for change.

We appreciate your support – not just for the game but for the world around us. Let’s stay on the right track and keep building something that matters. Thank you for reading, and happy Ocean Fest!

notes.title: New Features and Exciting Additions in Train Yard Builder!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Gamers![/h3]
We are thrilled to present the latest devlog, packed with exciting updates and announcements about Train Yard Builder. Below, you’ll find detailed descriptions of some of the new features along with screenshots that showcase what we've been working on lately.

[h3]New User Interface[/h3]
We’re introducing a completely revamped user interface that is not only more intuitive but also visually appealing. Our design team has focused on improving readability and navigation, making your gaming experience even more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/2af7befe7fa6298260aff05c7c474892bbf1132c.png[/img]

[h3]Model Painting[/h3]
One of the most anticipated features is the ability to paint models. You can now personalize your in-game objects by adding unique colors and patterns. The painting tools are easy to use, yet offer various artistic possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/706df101f9c1f7e0bedd58f6f7eb2a0f6f2c9030.gif[/img]

[h3]Modding![/h3]
In response to community requests, we’ve implemented a modding feature. You can now easily add your own modifications to the game and share them with other players. The interface is straightforward, and the sharing process is quick and hassle-free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/298cd0183901b8ce989e9d5a6d67747e65a1add7.png[/img]

[h3]Messaging and Task System[/h3]
We have also enhanced the in-game messaging system to streamline task management. Now, you can receive, review, and accept tasks directly from the messaging system. This feature also allows you to track task progress and communicate with task givers, making mission and goal completion much more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/89e157c0e01062d4151df7f0ac36fffbcba7b477.png[/img]

[h3]Museum Concept[/h3]
We’re working on a new location - the museum. Above, you can see a concept drawing and an early screenshot of this location under construction. The museum will be a place where players can showcase their models related to the game world’s history and interact with unique items and artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40812718/250a8face6fe25e6d227cb70808b0ea8c9527888.png[/img]

[h3]Summary[/h3]
We hope you enjoy these new additions and changes. Our team is working hard to continuously develop and improve the game based on your feedback and suggestions. Thank you for your ongoing support, and we invite you to try out the new features.

We eagerly await your feedback!
[h3]The Development Team
[/h3]

Whether you're an aspiring train conductor, a seasoned rail enthusiast, or simply someone who appreciates the world of locomotives, this event is tailor-made for you.

Step into the enchanting world of Train Yard Builder, where you can let your creativity soar and bring to life your very own miniature train universe.

Prepare yourself for an exhilarating journey filled with boundless imagination and infinite possibilities. Start your exciting adventure today!

notes.title: Back to the Future with Train Yard Builder
notes.notes:
[h1]We are thrilled to announce that the development of the highly anticipated game, Train Yard Builder, is progressing smoothly. 
[/h1]
[h3]We're excited to share some exclusive screenshots from the game development. In the pictures, you'll get a sneak peek of the diverse range of trains and wagons, from American brands to Polish ones, that will be included in the game.

Train Yard Builder is not just about building models, it's about building your own environment for models. With a range of available assets and modders tools to import new objects, you'll be free to bring your creations to life. Imagine designing the layout of your mini world, deciding the path of your trains, and placing track switches exactly where you want them. And that's not all - we're also allowing you to design custom table shapes, unleashing even greater creativity. Get ready to build a train model world that's truly your own.[/h3]

[h1]In addition to the campaign mode, we're also excited to offer a sandbox mode where you can let your imagination run wild. And the best part? You'll get to test the game later this year![/h1]
